questions.q: Name the six Holland types in the usual order around the hexagon.
questions.a: Realistic, Investigative, Artistic, Social, Enterprising, Conventional.

questions.q: How does SCCT differ from Holland's matching view?
questions.a: SCCT explains choice through beliefs (self-efficacy, outcome expectations, goals), Holland through the match of interest types to environments.
